headline: Garmin’s new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
summary: Garmin launched its new Fenix 9 smartwatches with a brighter OLED display. The Fenix 9 boasts 3,000 nits brightness and 50% more RAM. Base models start at $999.99.

headline: Trump is upping the price of Big Tech’s favorite visa
summary: DHS announced a new fee of over $103,000 for H-1B visas. The State Department plans to revoke visas for up to 200,000 asylum seekers. These changes significantly impact Big Tech.

headline: At just $8, you owe it to yourself to grab Inscryption
summary: The popular deckbuilder Inscryption is on sale for just $8 on Humble. It's from Daniel Mullins, creator of the upcoming Pony Island 2. Grab this critically acclaimed, secret-packed game at a fantastic discount.

headline: The Witcher 3 is getting a remaster
summary: CD Projekt Red is remastering The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. The updated game will launch on September 29th with improved visuals and combat. It also includes a reimagined skill tree and the first two games.

headline: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups Review
summary: "Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups" is reviewed as a sloppy gangster epic. Indian megastar Yash is featured in a blood-thirsty role. The film explores themes of violence and crime.

headline: Showa American Story: The First Hands-On Preview
summary: Showa American Story crafts an unforgettable, eccentric B-movie world. It is highly unique and fascinating but suffers from deliberate jank and a niche style. Combat depth and mechanical feel currently lag behind modern AAA action games.

headline: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank With Dual USB-C Cables Drops to Just $45.29
summary: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank is on sale for $45.29. It comes with dual USB-C cables and offers 140W output. This discount is accessible to everyone, not just Amazon Prime members.

headline: The Dog Stars Review
summary: Ridley Scott's "The Dog Stars" is a post-apocalyptic survivor drama. The film keeps its feelings about grieving in a triple layer of emotional bubble wrap. It offers a unique take on survival.

headline: How Dolly Parton told her life story through six iconic songs
summary: Dolly Parton's life story is told through six of her iconic songs. Her music covers themes of love, loss, female empowerment, and spirituality. The legendary singer-songwriter's legacy shines through her work.

headline: NHS failing child sex abuse victims in adulthood, say psychiatrists
summary: Psychiatrists report the NHS is failing adult child sex abuse victims. A new damning report details decades of mistreatment and mismanagement. Experts highlight issues for those seeking help later in life.

headline: Winter energy prices expected to rise to three-year high
summary: Winter energy prices are projected to reach a three-year high. Millions of households will be affected by an increase in the energy price cap. Regulator Ofgem is set to implement the new cap.

headline: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
summary: The CIA chief reportedly traveled to Moscow for unannounced talks. US media reports confirmed the unusual diplomatic visit. Flight tracking data shows an American military aircraft traveled via Latvia.
